claims.text: Williams (knee) is active for Monday night's game against the Commanders, Brooke Evans of the team's official site reports.

claims.author: Matt Maiocco
claims.text: The 49ers downgraded Kirk (calf) to out for Monday's game against the Commanders, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: Bradford (knee) was designated to return from injured reserve by the Seahawks on Monday, John Boyle of the team's official website reports.

claims.author: John Boyle
claims.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald confirmed with reporters Monday that Arroyo will miss "significant time" due to a shoulder injury that he picked up during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

claims.author: Gregg Bell
claims.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) is slated for a "full week of work" and has a "good chance" to play Sunday night against the Chiefs, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

claims.author: Brady Henderson
claims.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Price "should be looking at a sooner rather than later return after" the Seahawks' next game in Week 7, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

claims.author: Brady Henderson
claims.text: Knight will start in Thursday's game against the Broncos, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

claims.author: Brianna Dix
claims.text: Kieft (elbow) does not carry an injury designation into Thursday's game against the Cowboys, Brianna Dix of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

claims.author: John Keim
claims.text: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.

claims.author: Adam Schefter
claims.text: Diggs (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Monday's game at San Francisco, is in line to play, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
